Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner imposed an arbitrary “most recent appearance” criterion and included guest-judge roles, leading them to select RuPaul’s Drag Race and conclude the host was RuPaul. The question more naturally refers to Nicki Minaj’s role as a judge on American Idol, whose host is Ryan Seacrest. This misinterpretation set the investigation on the wrong target and produced an incorrect final answer.
